facts.text: The resort is located along the historic incense trade route against desert plains and the Hijaz Mountains.
facts.excerpt: Located along the historic incense trade route against the backdrop of desert plains and the Hijaz Mountains

facts.text: The resort's architecture pays homage to Nabataean architectural heritage and the desert surroundings.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea resort pays homage to Nabataean architectural heritage and majestic desert surroundings

facts.text: The resort is one of two inland locations in The Red Sea Development Project on Saudi Arabia's west coast.
facts.excerpt: Six Senses Southern Dunes, The Red Sea is one of two inland locations that, together with coastal and marine initiatives, form The Red Sea Development Project

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites surround the main Oasis complex, with pool villas dotted around the resort.
facts.excerpt: Surrounding our main Oasis complex is a collection of 36 guest rooms and suites, and a further 40 pool villas are dotted in strategic locations

facts.text: Interiors reflect the tones and textures of the dunes, with soft furnishings drawing on traditional Bedouin tribal dress.
facts.excerpt: with interiors reflecting the tones and textures of the sandy dunes and soft furnishings drawing from the rich colors and patterns of traditional Bedouin tribal dress
our guest rooms boast spectacular desert vistas and unique cultural charms

facts.text: The spa is set over two floors with self-shaded water surfaces.
facts.excerpt: Set over two floors, our spa features self-shaded water surfaces plus pioneering wellness facilities.

facts.text: The resort is open all year round.
facts.excerpt: We are open all year-round, and our on-site attractions are diverse in the truest Six Senses tradition.

facts.text: The resort is set among the Alnesai dunes.
facts.excerpt: pleasure-seekers who want to relax in the tranquility and serenity of the Alnesai dunes

facts.text: A cooking school by day becomes a private chef's table by night, focused on local gastronomy.
facts.excerpt: Cooking school by day and private chef’s table by night to learn the secrets of our relatively undiscovered local gastronomy.

facts.text: The signature restaurant serves flavors from Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Syria, Persia and Lebanon.
facts.excerpt: Signature restaurant serving authentic flavors from across Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Syria, Persia, and Lebanon.

facts.text: Destination dining is offered at out-of-the-ordinary locations in and around the resort.
facts.excerpt: Destination dining offering unforgettable dining experiences at out-of-the-ordinary locations in and around the resort.

facts.text: Experiences range from immersing in village life to adventure activities in the desert.
facts.excerpt: From immersing in village life to adventure activities in the desert, explore the beauty of the region.

facts.text: Freshly baked patisserie and complimentary ice cream and sorbet are available throughout the day.
facts.excerpt: Our freshly baked delicacies and complimentary ice cream and sorbet are available throughout the day.
